1.report: Implemented configurable per-profile root layer fractions in benchmarks/daily_water_growth.py (version 0.2.0): validated insertion-ordered case['root_layer_fractions'] (finite positive, exactly L entries, sum to 1 within 1e-12, no bool/NaN/inf, no silent normalization, needed grass/shrub names enforced only when no explicit IDs), L=1/2/3 defaults plus bounded generic defaults, optional inputs['root_profile_id'] validated (integer dtype, not bool/float, shape, range) before conversion/allocation/transfer, contiguous FP64 table [S,L] + int32 IDs [P] fixed across weekly growth. CPU njit and GPU kernels now scatter R[l,j] += Dp*w*f[id,l] directly into the resident R (Rh removed) and gather exactly the same requested pieces times the same scale. Memory formula/ledger/live arrays/mirrors updated (n_profiles kwarg, default 2); summary audits add profile validity and requested-total checks at report boundaries only; warmups exercise new signatures, three profiles and explicit IDs on GPU. Tests add RootProfileTests (analytical expectations) and a GPU parity test; docs updated with JSON example, ordering, defaults, validation, conservation and version/memory note.
1.known_limitations: Not executed by the author. Tests assume sm root graphs for a circle inside a single 10 m cell yield count 1/weight 1 and that sm.validate_inputs accepts radius-1 plants at (5,5) on a 1x1 dx=10 grid; if sm rejects such geometry the one-cell tests need a different domain. The requested-total audit uses 1e-8 relative tolerance to absorb sm weight-normalization error. Explicit list IDs are validated with a Python loop over the list (ndarray inputs use dtype checks only). For very large L the generic default rows may exceed the 1e-12 normalization tolerance (documented). The CUDA kernels index frac as a flat S*L array; CuPy must pass a contiguous float64 table (ensured via ascontiguousarray). Independent follow-up measurement is still required.

2.report: Corrections: (1) sm.generate_inputs now receives only sm.CASE_FIELDS via _geometry_case (also in GPU warmup); validate_case no longer injects root_layer_fractions=None; added a generated CPU run test and a CLI JSON regression with configured profiles. (2) Split pure validation (validate_root_layer_fractions returns names without copying rows; check_profile_ids inspects without conversion) from materialization (build_root_profile_table, materialize_profile_ids) which now run only after the aggregate init_bound preflight that includes profile mirrors; default-table byte guard moved out of validate_case so run_case returns status='rejected'; added mock-recorded ordering/refusal regression without large allocations. (3) scratch_allowance(P,N,L,n_profiles=2) adds S*L + 8*S profile-audit temporaries; actual S passed through all ledgers and the memory report. (4) Tests with test-only W overwrites now assert the audit residual equals the explicitly tracked external change with all other invariants true, plus a fresh unmodified 7-day run for full budget/growth; GPU heterogeneous test sets W0 to the chosen initial total before any advance. (5) Separate timed/synchronized profile H2D record (4P+8SL) and transfer_summary in results. (6) grass/shrub rows required only for classes actually present (counts before generation; is_shrub after supplied inputs); np.where no longer eagerly indexes absent names; tests cover grass-only, shrub-only, missing-required refusal and arbitrary names with explicit IDs. Kernels, fixture constants, caps and populations unchanged.
2.known_limitations: Not executed. Assumes sm.CASE_FIELDS iterates the original geometry field names (dict keys or sequence); a fallback drops only root_layer_fractions if the attribute is absent.
